snippet.title: Swords and Their Boy Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Swords and Their Boy is an atmospheric 2.5D sci-fi souls-like action about two AI swords using a mortally wounded boy to finish their task - cleanse an alien planet before its colonization.
